result.summary: Removed the leftover duplicate useShellConfig call in RealDashboard so the existing "single call site" comment in ProductDashboardScreen is now factually true.
result.report:
Blocker: DashboardScreen.tsx had a comment at lines 136-141 claiming useShellConfig was called only once (in ProductDashboardScreen), but RealDashboard (the child rendered in the same tree) still called useShellConfig again at lines 331-337 with an equivalent but separately computed config (active, attention, module, source, title). This was dead-weight redundancy left over from a prior incomplete edit, contradicting the comment.

Fix: deleted the second useShellConfig(...) call inside RealDashboard (previously at lines 331-337), right after the `today` date computation and before the `return (` of the JSX. No other logic in RealDashboard changed — primaryIssue, attentionCount, and external remain used elsewhere in that function's JSX (banners, badges, status strip), so no unused variables were introduced. ProductDashboardScreen's existing call (lines 142-158) already computes equivalent attention/source values via dashboardNeedsAttention()/dashboardSource() for the loaded-dashboard case, so shell config behavior for the dashboard route is unchanged; only the duplicate call site was removed.

Commands executed and results:
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` (apps/frontend) → no output, exit clean.
- `npx eslint src/features/dashboard/DashboardScreen.tsx` (apps/frontend) → no output, exit clean.
- `npx vitest run` (apps/frontend) → 14 test files passed, 101 tests passed.
- `grep -n "useShellConfig" src/features/dashboard/DashboardScreen.tsx` → confirms exactly one call remains (the import line plus the single invocation inside ProductDashboardScreen; the comment referencing it).

No other files touched. Did not commit, push, or change branch, per constraints.

acceptance.criterion: Blocker 1 resolvido: a chamada duplicada de useShellConfig em RealDashboard (antes em DashboardScreen.tsx:331-337) foi removida, tornando o comentário 'Único ponto de useShellConfig desta tela' em DashboardScreen.tsx:136-141 factualmente correto.
acceptance.detail: Edit removeu o bloco useShellConfig({...}) de RealDashboard; grep confirma apenas uma invocação de useShellConfig no arquivo (dentro de ProductDashboardScreen). tsc, eslint e vitest (101 testes) passaram sem erros após a mudança.
